notes: M1.4 full-song revision pilot created after the M1.3 A set was rejected as too sparse and sketch-like. The source motif is a recurring hook rather than continuous accompaniment. The ViceBlood arrangement adds continuous G-funk drums/percussion, melodic funk bass, Rhodes bed, clav chops, original mono lead, counter melody, pad, brass and transitions across a 56-bar A/B/breakdown/return structure. General MIDI remains a placeholder; the listening gate is about whether this now feels like a complete song. User review: materially better, but revise toward more hip-hop and more funk; B is not yet an accepted station reference.

reviewFeedback.whatWorked: The complete-song structure is materially better than the rejected M1.3 A sketches.
reviewFeedback.revisionNeed: Reduce soundtrack/cinematic weight and make hip-hop drums plus funk bass/riffs the primary identity.
